items.name: seedance-drama-maker
items.description: Seedance Drama Maker — turn one sentence into a cinematic AI short drama. Multi-agent pipeline powered by SeeDance 2.5 (30s shots, 50 reference inputs, 14 languages, native audio-video sync), SeeDream 5.0 Pro image generation, FastAPI + WebSocket.

items.name: Split-Node-YouTube
items.description: Split Node - Local-First YouTube Documentary Content Pipeline w/ API support. RSS in, 25-min cinematic documentary out: runs free on an 8GB GPU (images+LLM+voice+music+render), with optional cloud image/video APIs (fal.ai, RunPod, Replicate).

items.name: ManhwaForge
items.description: Automated pipeline transforming manhwa and webtoon PDFs into cinematic AI recap videos with OCR, LLM narration, and TTS voiceover

items.name: YukkuriGenerator
items.description: AI story-video generator: yukkuri avatar videos & cinematic folktale animations via ComfyUI (MiniMax H3) + VOICEVOX + local LLM. Fully automated script-to-YouTube pipeline.

items.name: Local_AI_Factory
items.description: Fully automated local AI video pipeline: from parsing trends to rendering and publishing cinematic shorts using LLMs, ComfyUI, and official social APIs.

items.name: YT_Automate
items.description: YT_Automate is an end-to-end pipeline that automatically generates stunning, cinematic short videos (16:9 or 9:16) themed around any brand or concept, using LLMs and video generation models. It also prepares YouTube metadata and uploads the video—all in one command.

items.name: dnd-video-pipeline
items.description: AI pipeline that converts D&D audio sessions into cinematic videos using speech-to-text, LLM orchestration, and text-to-video models

items.name: Cinematic-Captioner
items.description: A modular, Python-based pipeline for downloading, transcribing, and processing video content. This project leverages multiple LLM providers to handle complex reasoning and captioning tasks.  **Key Features:**

items.name: video-narration-analysis-pipeline
items.description: This pipeline should generate detailed and engaging narratives, including all the specific actions and emotional journey in the video. The prompt engineering will guide the LLMs to create professional, cinematic narratives that focus on the key elements of the salon experience.

items.name: Historical-Videos-Generator
items.description: AI pipeline that turns any historical topic into a cinematic 48-second short video — Groq LLM + ComfyUI + Edge-TTS + Whisper + FFmpeg, orchestrated with N8N

items.name: Prompt-to-Video-Engine
items.description: An end-to-end automated video production pipeline that transforms text prompts into cinematic short-form content using local LLMs, TTS, and image generation engines.

items.name: AI-Storyteller-Studio
items.description: End-to-end AI pipeline to generate stories, characters, scenes, voiceovers, and compile them into cinematic videos.

items.name: ProductURL_to_Video
items.description: Built on the BytePlus SDK, this pipeline takes a product URL, scrapes the name, description, and image, refines them using Seed LLM, and generates a cinematic video prompt submitted to Seedance to generate product videos

items.name: OrcheStudio
items.description: OrcheStudio is a flexible, modular framework for automating the entire video production lifecycle. It serves as a digital director that coordinates Large Language Models (LLMs) for scripting, advanced TTS engines for narration, and cinematic rendering pipelines to create professional video content for any platform.

items.name: Toksmith-2
items.description: TokSmith is an AI production engine orchestrating a multi-modal pipeline to transform raw social content into cinematic short-form video assets. The platform automates content extraction, LLM-driven script synthesis, and expressive voice synthesis for highly engaging digital narrative adaptation. Developed with FastAPI and Next.js.
